snippet.title: Samurai’s Odyssey – New Indie Adventure Game Coming to Steam | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
🗡️ Samurai’s Odyssey is a story-driven indie adventure set in a distant, war-torn land.
Follow a lone warrior on a journey through abandoned villages, ancient ruins, and silent battles for honor and redemption.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam now and support the game:
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3624120/Samurais_Odyssey

🌸 A handcrafted experience.
🔥 An emotional path.
⚔️ A samurai’s silence speaks louder than words.

🎨 Indie project
💠 Adventure 
📅 Coming 2025
